name: type:feat
description: New behavior, capability or supported workflow

name: type:fix
description: Correction to broken, incorrect or regressed behavior

name: type:nit
description: Small polish, copy adjustment or low-risk cleanup

name: priority:high
description: Needed soon, blocks other work or materially affects core behavior

name: priority:medium
description: Valuable, but not urgent or blocking

name: phase:research
description: Establish facts needed to shape a testable specification

name: phase:refinement
description: Define scope, acceptance criteria and verification scenarios

name: phase:implementation
description: Implement the features the specification describes

name: phase:qa
description: Independently judge the change against its specification using evidence for the tested commit

name: status:doing
description: Work is actively in progress in the current phase

name: status:blocked
description: Required input is unavailable; record the missing prerequisite and resume condition

name: status:duplicate
description: Tracks the same outcome as another work item
